headline: Google Philippines says it aims to train more than one million public school teachers in AI through a programme with the country's Department of Education.
score_reason: Large teacher-training aim by a company; goal not result, no change from pool score.
importance_line: Filipino public school teachers and their students are affected; the one-million figure is Google's goal, and the programme is online and self-paced, so take-up is not yet known.
summary: BusinessWorld Online reports that Google Philippines, working with the Department of Education, aims to upskill over 1 million public school teachers in AI, using short self-paced online modules that earn digital badges. Country manager Prep Palacios cited a 2025 Digital Education Council survey showing 86% of teachers want to use technology but only 17% feel confident and trained, and the courses are being linked to licence-renewal credits through the National Educators Academy of the Philippines.
